title: AG60117: Fat And Oil Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Biological significance of lipids, classification occurrence, chemical and
physical characteristics of lipids: Triglycerides and phospholipids; emulsions
and emulsifiers; Inter-esterifications.
Industrial fats and oils, shortenings, salad oils, margarine, non-caloric fats;
standard and quality control, packaging and storage of fats and fatty foods.
Changes during processing and storage of oils and fats, polymorphism, rancidity
and reversion.
Processing of oil seeds and other oil bearing materials, extraction of oils and
fats, rendering and trying out, mechanical expression of oil by hydraulic
pressing and expelling, semi-continuous and continuous solvent extraction
systems, distillation for separation of oil and solvent, design concept for
solvent extraction system for oil bearing material, physical and chemical
refining of oils, hydrogenation.
Special uses of fat for several foods, like chocolate, bread, biscuit,
mayonnaise, salad, frying, etc.
Non conventional edible oils, oil seed cakes and meal utilization: By-products
of oils and fats processing industries, manufacturing techniques for glycerine,
soaps, detergents, polishes and paints.
Oleoresins and essential oils-its physical and chemical characteristics,
extraction methodology and down-stream processing, application, storage,
packaging and analysis of oleoresin and essential oils; Toxicity and safety of
fats and oils.
